opus.problem: The cited verse Genesis 23:1 gives only her age of 127. Her death at Hebron in Canaan is in Genesis 23:2, so this part of the clue is not supported by its reference.
Genesis 18:12 says only that she laughed to herself. The tent entrance and the LORD's promise of a son come from Genesis 18:10, so part of the clue is not in its cited verse.
Naming her as the woman who bore Isaac to Abraham gives the answer away on its own. It is not medium hard.
